parts.text:
Done. Module `example.com/mapx` with a fluent `map[string]interface{}` API; `gofmt`, `go vet`, and `go test` all pass.

```go
m := mapx.New(nil).
    Set("user.name", "ada").
    Set("user.tags[]", "math").
    Set("user.tags[]", "code")

name := m.Get("user.name").String()   // "ada"
first := m.Get("user.tags[0]").String() // "math"
```

Files:
- `map.go:1` — chainable `Map`: `New`, `FromJSON`, `Get`, `Set`, `Delete`, `Has`, `Merge`, `Clone`, `Filter`, `Each`, `Keys`, JSON marshal.
- `value.go:1` — `Value` with `String/Int/Float/Bool` + `*Or` fallbacks and `Slice/Strings/Map`.
- `path.go:1` — dot/`[n]`/`[]` path parsing plus get/set/delete/deep-copy/merge.
- `map_test.go:1` — coverage for nesting, arrays, deep merge, clone, conversions, JSON round-trip.

Path notes: `a.b.c`, `arr[0]`, `arr.0` (numeric key on a slice), `arr[]` appends. Set auto-creates missing containers. Change the module path in `go.mod:1` to your repo when ready.
